items.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: And the Bloom lady? ... Uh huh. She’s serious.

ctx.x: Like they’ve been treated in other professions, not too good. But it’s improving as I see some of the younger women musicians playing. Not a whole lot, but I saw, recently there was some television shows that were using an all-women’s band. But it was like a gimmick thing again, like going back to that gimmick thing and I don’t like that. Terri Lyne Carrington, she’s a marvelous drummer. And the Bloom lady?

Uh huh. She’s serious. And there’s a violinist here, I speak to her every now and then, can’t think of her name right now. I think she’s out of the road with, what’s this guy’s name? He’s real big in the New Age sound?
